subject.title: [Bug]: Codex OAuth profile in main agentDir does not propagate to subagent sessions — silent fallback hallucinates tool calls in production

question: Should #87051 remain the canonical tracker for spawned-subagent Codex/OpenAI OAuth inheritance, or should maintainers split the remaining failures into narrower runtime/auth and announce-delivery issues after live proof?
rationale: Current main has partial source and test fixes, but the remaining behavior involves the intended product contract for child runtime/auth inheritance and silent fallback visibility.

options.title: Keep canonical and prove live
options.body: Keep #87051 open as the broad canonical tracker until a live current-main Codex/OAuth subagent run proves the intended runtime/auth path and delivery behavior.

options.title: Split remaining failures
options.body: Move remaining source-backed failures to narrower issues such as #89549 and #90925, then close #87051 only after the split explicitly covers silent fallback and main OAuth inheritance.

options.title: Close after current-main proof
options.body: Close #87051 only if maintainers run a current-main live repro showing spawned subagents inherit or resolve main Codex/OpenAI OAuth without fallback or delivery loss.

recommendation.title: Keep canonical and prove live
recommendation.body: Keep #87051 open as the broad canonical tracker until a live current-main Codex/OAuth subagent run proves the intended runtime/auth path and delivery behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved decision spans subagent spawn/model-selection and OpenAI provider identity history where steipete has recent connected work.
